memory_notes: index_owned_bytes is the sum of memory_breakdown()'s nine fields (block bytes, model tables, region prefixes, overflow containers, capacity tables, boundary directories, per-region objects, fences, index-level metadata); the fields are disjoint by construction, so the sum is not double-counted. adapter_owned_bytes covers only the adapter object and its query Mode. retained_input_bytes is 0 because the Row->Pair conversion buffer is released after bulk_load and the implementation holds its own copy. Returned rows from scan are owned by the caller and are not counted here.

Capacity-based estimate; borrowed input counted in full. Excludes allocator headers, deque spare blocks/map, transient training/merge allocations. Not peak RSS; IDs/tags are owned, payloads of bulk rows are borrowed.
